subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the Talk/Voice tab follow Chat's selected session, expose its own agent/session picker, or wait for a shared companion-app Talk target model?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the permanent target-state model affects Android and possibly iOS/macOS companion UX, so automation should not pick it as a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk selection first using existing gateway agent/session data, then validate a real multi-agent Talk route before expanding the pattern.

options.title: Follow Chat selection
options.body: Make Voice/Talk reuse the active Chat target to keep one mobile session state, accepting tighter coupling between the two tabs.

options.title: Shared companion-app design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one cross-platform Talk/Voice selector model for Android, iOS, and macOS.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk selection first using existing gateway agent/session data, then validate a real multi-agent Talk route before expanding the pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the implemented TTS half versus the remaining Talk/Voice selector work and is tied to the canonical per-agent TTS path.
